content.short: Hypersurface brings volatility yield onchain, letting holders earn while holding assets.
content.description: Hypersurface turns volatility into yield for ordinary holders on Hyperliquid, packaging option-selling strategies so that earning a premium does not require managing a position. Selling volatility produces steady income until it does not, and the honest question about any such product is what happens to the seller during a sharp move.
